# Parse the note content to extract song info
import re

content = note['content']
lines = content.strip().split('\n')[1:]  # skip header
songs = []
for line in lines:
    # Format: - Title BY Artist1, Artist2 RELEASED_AT MM/YYYY or TODO
    m = re.match(r'- (.+) BY (.+) RELEASED_AT (.+)', line)
    if m:
        title = m.group(1).strip()
        artists_str = m.group(2).strip()
        release = m.group(3).strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
        songs.append({'title': title, 'artists': artists, 'release': release})

# Show the TODO songs
todo_songs = [s for s in songs if s['release'] == 'TODO']
print(f"Total songs: {len(songs)}, TODO: {len(todo_songs)}")
for s in todo_songs:
    print(s)
